parsed.rationale: Both records are unnamed `extension` declarations on `Bundle` — one in `Shared/Playlist/Sources/Playlist/Bundle+Playlist.swift` (package `Playlist`) and one in `Shared/Caching/Sources/Caching/CacheMigrationManager.swift` (package `Caching`). The structural evidence carries no Jaccard similarity, no shared fields, and no shared ancestor, meaning the only signal is that both extend the same Foundation type. `Bundle` extensions are a standard Swift idiom for locating package-local resources; each package legitimately needs its own extension to resolve its own bundle, so the duplication is domain-driven and intentional rather than accidental. Merging them would couple two unrelated packages (`Playlist` and `Caching`) for no semantic gain.
